messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled: soft-unpin runtime v2.15 on eu-west-1 canary at 2024-09-02T01:30Z. Traffic: 3% for 20m. Command: `deploybot unpin runtime v2.15 --canary eu-west-1 --pct 3 --dur 20m --annot 'safety-watch'`
Lina: Quick note — this runtime changes batch merging for short-seq workloads. Shouldn't affect prompt-only flows but could impact batched embed requests.
Omar: What detectors do we want? I'm thinking: 1) embedding_mean_shift > 0.02 over 10m, 2) 5xx_rate > 2% on model endpoint, 3) anomalous_latency_p90 +50ms.
Devraj: Add one more: `metric(kv_cache_misalignment) > 10 in 5m` — our longseq harness reports that.
Becky: Ops ask: please include `--dry-run` first so we can validate the command syntax and expected diff in pinlist before actual change.
deploy-bot: Good idea. Run plan shown:
```
# dry-run
deploybot unpin runtime v2.15 --canary eu-west-1 --pct 3 --dur 20m --annot "safety-watch" --dry-run
```
Will output candidate pinlist changes in /var/deploybot/plans/1824681357.json
Lina: Also, add a header `X-Runtime-Compatible: 2.13,2.14,2.15` on responses during canary so SDKs can detect.
Omar: SDK compatibility: clients on sdk-python >=1.5.0 are OK; <1.5 need workaround. Can we gate by user-agent? NOT ideal. Better: telemetry tag + release note.
Devraj: I'll prepare a small SDK hotfix to reject sessions with runtime 2.15 unless users opt into experimental-shim. Can push to canary channel.
Becky: On-call: @Omar you'll be primary; @Devraj backup. ops-bot will page if any threshold tripped.
ops-bot: Reminder: I will page on alerts: embedding_mean_shift, kv_cache_misalignment, endpoint_5xx. I will also create temporary runbook link and pin to #eng-oncall.
Lina: For rollback policy: try immediate canary pinback for 10 minutes. If problems persist after 10m, escalate to global pin (all regions) and notify security & customer-success.
Omar: Agreed. Also annotate the rollback with reason codes, e.g., `--annotation "embed_drift"` so audit logs are searchable.
Devraj: I'll run longseq samples every 2 minutes and paste diffs here if I see degradation.
Becky: Release-notes: include a short blurb and a dev-facing note: "If you see token misalignment on long inputs, pin runtime to 2.14." Draft: https://redwood.internal/releases/drafts/2-15-unpin-notes
Lina: small operational ask: please delay unpin by +15m if paperwork (change window approvals) not stamped. We should not start until approvals are in.
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Will re-run dry-run and post final invocation 10m before the window. Will tag @eng-oncall and @customer-success before global pin.
Omar: ok. keeping watchers on this thread during the window. If nothing fires, plan to ramp to 10% after 4h.
Lina: thanks team.
